description: Convert 486 gigajoules of metered steam to kilowatt hours. DISTILL-CANARY-b5220c6c

files.README.md:
# Camphill Creamery - energy office

Boiler steam is metered in gigajoules at each plant.
The monthly return to the energy office is filed in kilowatt hours.

turns.prompt: Camphill Creamery is filing the September energy return. The steam meter at Camphill Two read 486 gigajoules over the month. The return is filed in kilowatt hours. How many kilowatt hours did the meter read? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
